author: Hoang Tran
tagline: Production-ready Claude AI projects you can deploy in an afternoon

kits.name: AI Phone Receptionist Kit
kits.summary: Answers a real phone number for a clinic, salon or shop: books appointments, takes messages, puts urgent callers through. Claude + Deepgram + Twilio, with a call dashboard.

kits.name: Vacation Rental AI Concierge Kit
kits.summary: A 24/7 guest assistant for Airbnb hosts and homestays: answers in any language, stay codes for door and wifi, host inbox, Telegram and email alerts, reply drafts.

kits.name: MCP Server Starter Kit
kits.summary: A production remote MCP server in Python: API keys with read and write scopes, rate limits, audit log, HTTPS and a one-command AWS deploy.

kits.name: DocSift: Document Extraction Kit
kits.summary: Invoices, receipts and VAT invoices to clean data: upload, review side by side, total checks, CSV and Excel export, webhooks. About 3 cents per document.

kits.name: AWS Document Chatbot Kit
kits.summary: Chat with your PDFs with cited answers. Passwords, rate limits, a daily spend cap, HTTPS and a one-command AWS deploy.

kits.name: Lead Research Agent Kit
kits.summary: Three LangGraph agents research a company, write a personal outreach email and review it. Batch CSV of hundreds of leads, about $0.23 per lead.

kits.name: Customer Support Agent Kit
kits.summary: A tool-using support agent with a one-line chat widget, order lookups, and a team inbox where staff take over and hand back. About $0.05 per conversation.
